plan.paradox: Standing tickets start cheap, then skyrocket while you wait
plan.odd_fact: First price listed £148.50, later £355. Sounds like a glitch.
plan.twist: It's surge pricing, a queue price trick
plan.cause: Ticketmaster watches the queue length and lifts prices once demand spikes, turning the standing tickets you held into the 'in demand' tier at £355
plan.everyday: Cinema: cheap seats £8, popular rows £15. Gym: basic membership £20, high-demand plan £30, makes the higher tier feel smart. Both use queue-driven price hikes to push the pricier option
plan.rule: When you wait, expect the price to jump. Follow for more.
